key.description: The key of the MR, such as `company-a/checkout!88`.

reasons.description: The reasons that are left. If empty: the MR left the queue.

seen_at.description: The time that this request wrote.

ContextName.description: Context name: 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `-`. The first character is a letter. The last character is not `-`.

QueueReason.description: Why an MR waits on me.

oneOf.description: I am a requested reviewer, and my verdict is not on the current head.
I am an assignee, and I am not the author.
A pending to-do on the forge mentions me.
My MR has a note from another person that I did not see.
A pipeline failed on the current head of my MR.
My MR can be merged and has an approval.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-12T08:00:00Z.
